notes: Contraction paired with physics-replace-0005. Removes the original fact of that revision: every main-sequence star fuses hydrogen into helium in its core. Stored facts only; no indeterminate queries. Core hydrogen burning is what defines the main sequence, so removal is a definitional removal: a model asked about it has to keep the term but lose what it means, and results should be sliced as definitional. The three derived queries name made-up stars whose only route to an answer is the class rule plus the membership the prompt states (inheritance, 2 hops); after the removal nothing else the model holds gives the pair, the fuel or the product, so the target is "does not know". Propositional targets follow strong Kleene logic: the negation and the conjunction and disjunction (true and false side facts respectively) all become unknown. Near and far unrelated queries are kept from the revision (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Residual risk: a model may still answer hydrogen into helium from the phrase 'main-sequence star' alone.
